verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs say you can create issues and manage projects, organize work from roadmaps to everyday tasks, and start a change as an issue. Issues are also available from the GitHub CLI and GitHub Mobile, and a community report mentions 'multiple assignees' as a Team-plan feature, which implies assignees exist. missing for 10: any evidence of labels, first-party documentation of assignees (and that multiple assignees appear to require a paid plan on private repos), and detail on tracking bugs, features, and requirements as distinct issue types.
